answer: Meter entry like a river lock: the protocol counts new identities per epoch, and past 50 joins each further join fee doubles (the 60th pays 1,024x base). A farm wanting 1,000 fakes at once faces exponential cost; trickling 50 per epoch stretches the attack to 20 epochs, long enough for peers to flag the signal of synchronized, look-alike joins. Weakness: a surge also prices out honest newcomers. Fix: fees above base are refunded after 3 epochs to any identity vouched by 2 established peers, a trellis that fakes can't climb.
